translation:
<ins>Sage Healing Decoction (聖愈湯)</ins>
Ginseng (人參), chuanxiong (川芎), dang gui (當歸), cooked rehmannia (熟地黃), raw rehmannia (生地), astragalus (黃耆, honey-fried, each equal parts)
Decoct in water and take. <ins>Four Gentlemen Decoction (四君子湯)</ins> and <ins>Single Ginseng Decoction (獨參湯)</ins> (both are found under injury with bleeding, 傷損出血)
